title: 휴대폰이 꺼졌어요: 전자제품 고장과 충전 말하기
objective: By the end, you can use words like 고장, 배터리, 충전하다, and 고치다 in short sentences to say what is wrong with a device and what needs to be done.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for using electronics, charging them, and talking about breakdowns and repairs.

task.title: Use the device words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write, order, or answer using the words from page 1.

words.example: 세탁기가 고장 나서 빨래를 못 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The washing machine broke, so I couldn't do the laundry.
I charge my phone before I go to bed.
Could you lend me your charger?
A technician is coming tomorrow to install the air conditioner.
They say it will take a week to fix the laptop.
I plugged it in, but the power won't come on.

words.meaning: to turn off, to shut down (by itself)

exercises: Choose the right word (고장 / 충전기 / 설치): ① 휴대폰을 충전하고 싶은데 ____를 집에 두고 왔어요. ② 냉장고가 ____ 나서 음식이 다 상했어요. ③ 새 프린터를 ____하는 방법을 몰라요.
Choose 켜다 or 꺼지다 and write it in the past polite form (-았/었어요): ① 너무 더워서 선풍기를 ____. ② 충전을 안 해서 휴대폰이 ____.
Fill in the blank with 충전하다 in the -아/어야 해요 form: 배터리가 5%밖에 없어요. 지금 ____.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 고치다: 기사님이 오셔서 고장 난 세탁기를 ____ 주셨어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 눌러 / 전원 / 주세요 / 버튼을
Read and answer Yes or No: 「A: 휴대폰이 왜 꺼졌어요? B: 배터리가 하나도 없어요. 충전기 있어요?」 ① Is B's phone broken? ② Does B need a charger?
answers: ① 충전기 ② 고장 ③ 설치
① No (the battery is just empty) ② Yes
